capabilities: Browse and triage RSS and Atom feeds with keyboard navigation
Save articles as Markdown notes with customizable frontmatter and body templates
Track Read Later and Favorites lists stored as vault files
Import and export subscriptions as OPML, YAML, or TOML
Generate AI summaries and topic tags via local CLI agents
extras: Desktop-only (macOS, Windows, Linux) with minimum Obsidian version 1.8.7; no mobile support. Article content is cached in IndexedDB outside the vault to avoid cluttering sync.
intentEvidence: without relying on third-party cloud aggregators (no Feedly account required)
motivation: The author built it to bring an efficient feed reading experience directly into Obsidian without third-party cloud aggregators.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in feed reader, so following and triaging feeds means leaving the app or relying on cloud aggregators like Feedly.

relations.evidence: without relying on third-party cloud aggregators (no Feedly account required)
generate structured AI summaries with topic tags using local CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, pi)

requires.name: local AI CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, pi)

summary: RSS and Atom feed reader that displays feeds inside Obsidian and saves selected articles as templated Markdown notes.
